corpus.text: Incident Severity Classification: SEV-1 corresponds to total production outage affecting 50% or more of customer traffic. Escalation to VP of Engineering is required within 15 minutes.
Change Advisory Board (CAB) reviews all normal changes every Tuesday at 10:00 UTC. Emergency changes bypass scheduled CAB but require retrospective review within 48 hours.

Emergency Access Provisioning (Break-Glass Protocol): Requires dual authorization from CISO and Incident Commander. Checkout duration cannot exceed four hours and automatically creates a Jira audit ticket.
Data Retention Standard: All system access logs must be retained in encrypted cold storage for at least 365 days to comply with SOC2 and ISO27001 regulatory mandates.
Post-Mortem Policy: Blameless post-incident reviews must be completed within 5 business days for all SEV-1 and SEV-2 incidents. Action items are assigned SLA of 30 calendar days.
Database Migration Guidelines: Zero-downtime migrations require backward-compatible schema changes, phased column deprecation, and canary verification in staging prior to production deploy.
